name: Cyberman Patrol

ability.text: Whenever ~ becomes blocked, defending player loses 3 life.

abilities.text: Artifact creatures you control have afflict 3.

notes: Afflict 3 (CR 702.131a) is exactly 'whenever this creature becomes blocked, defending player loses 3 life', so the line is a grant-ability static handing that trigger to every artifact creature its controller controls — Cyberman Patrol itself included, so the filter carries no 'other'. filter.typesAll makes 'Artifact, Creature' an AND (characteristics.ts:236); lose-life who 'defending-player' resolves to src.attacking (game.ts:1349), the player the granted creature was attacking when it became blocked. The engine has no 'afflict' keyword, so the trigger is written out.

problems: round trip 0.40 < 0.55: "Artifact creatures you control have afflict 3." rendered as "artifact creature you control has \"whenever ~ becomes blocked, defending player loses 3 life\""
